project.name: my-browser-rust-chromium
project.description: Rust front-end + Chromium (CEF) backend browser. Clean Chrome TLS fingerprint (BoringSSL) + full UI control in Rust. Sibling to my-browser-qute.

libcef.note: cef-rs download-cef fetches prebuilt libcef; pin version + sha256 in flake.nix as a fixed-output derivation. NOT built from Chromium source.

release.note: mirror da_my-browser-qute's nix-bundle portable pipeline once buildable
